newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon adds 3-yr piece to mega-debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon adds 3-yr piece to mega-debt deal.

text.p: Raytheon Co plans to add a tranche of up to $500 million in three-year debt to its $2.5 billion debt offering, expected to be priced on Thursday, several market sources said.
Price talk on the new tranche was heard at 33 to 35 basis points over comparable Treasuries, the sources said.
The new tranche is being added to meet strong investor demand for short-term maturities, a source said.
The addition of the new debt could increase the size of the deal to $3.0 billion, the maximum amount allowed under Raytheon's existing shelf registration.
Sources said the remainder of the deal is still expected to consist of $1.0 billion in five-year debt, $1.0 billion in 10-year debt and $500 million in 30-year debt.
